en.title: heparin sodium injection: Highlights, Contraindications has no instruction for a patient the label covers
en.summary: Highlights, Contraindications reads “Severe thrombocytopenia”. Example: Highlights lists severe thrombocytopenia as a contraindication; section 4 does not, and section 4 lists HIT or HITT history and hypersensitivity, which Highlights omits. The same text is in 28 labels from 16 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.

ai_role.en: AI agents read the labels, compared their parts and, where marked, ran the example patient through executable rules; an AI agent then read each place in full, with tables and footnotes, and confirmed it. No clinician has assessed these places. A person at Arxo approved publication (2026-10-31).
